# WaterfallChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders cumulative variance bridges (P&L, cash flow, ARR movement) with delta, subtotal, and total bars.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new WaterfallChart(options?: WaterfallChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`barStyle`](#barstyle): Corner rounding and gradient style applied to waterfall bars.
- [`barWidthRatio`](#barwidthratio): Fraction of each category slot occupied by the bar (`0..1`).
- [`negativeColor`](#negativecolor): Override colour for negative delta bars.
- [`positiveColor`](#positivecolor): Override colour for positive delta bars.
- [`showConnectors`](#showconnectors): Whether to draw dashed connector lines between adjacent bars.
- [`showSignOnDeltas`](#showsignondeltas): Whether to prefix positive delta labels with `+`.
- [`svgShapeRendering`](#svgshaperendering): SVG `shape-rendering` hint (`auto` or `crispEdges`).
- [`totalColor`](#totalcolor): Override colour for total and subtotal bars.
